I seal the draft that wrongly stated my brother’s destination. It records both an error and my attempt to leave a route another person can follow. Next: the ferry hall enquiry window, to decide how the record will meet future readers.

note.zh: 留证三步完成。去候船室问讯窗口，选择具名查阅或匿名封存。
note.en: Evidence tasks complete. Visit the ferry hall enquiry window: attributed access or anonymous custody.

text.zh:
我决定留下，但留下不能只是一句献给自己的漂亮话。罗医生请我先到诊所帘后的病床，问清顾先生愿意接受什么照顾；再去后弄煤炉旁安排取水与夜班；最后到候船室靠窗长凳，与来接班的人把事情说透。
人不该因为成为我的救赎，就失去自己选择生活的权利。今晚我要学的，可能是怎样帮忙而不替人做主。
text.en:
I choose to stay, but staying cannot be a fine sentence addressed only to myself. Luo asks me to visit the curtained bed and learn what care Gu will accept, arrange water and night watches by the rear-court stove, then meet the next helper on the ferry hall window bench.
Being part of my redemption must not cost somebody their right to choose a life. Tonight I may need to learn how to help without taking command.

text.zh:
顾先生没有睡着。他听见我说要留下照顾他，先问了一个让我答不上来的问题：“留下多久？”我想说一直，罗医生却把空水杯放在我手里，让我先去倒一杯温水。
回来时，顾先生正在把鞋子摆齐。他说自己还会走路，也能记住喜欢喝什么茶，只是有些日子不能独自出门。我不能因为他忘了一些事情，就把他整个人放进“需要照顾”的一格。
text.en:
Gu is awake. When I offer to stay and care for him, he asks how long. I nearly say forever. Luo puts an empty cup in my hand and asks for warm water first.
When I return, Gu is aligning his shoes. He can still walk and remember his preferred tea, though some days he cannot go out alone. Forgetting some things does not place his entire person inside a box marked needs care.

text.zh:
床边放着一张旧照片，我认得青芜，却不认得旁边那个拿饭盒的人。顾先生说那是多年以前来听课的学生，后来不常见面，偶尔还替他送药。他要求我们不要把这张照片给别人看，不愿每个熟悉的人都被拉进今晚的事情。
我把照片翻扣回来。罗医生在值班本上只记“家属保管”，没有把我当作当然的家属。想替一个人撑住生活，第一步竟是承认自己还不知道多少门该敲，多少抽屉不该打开。
text.en:
An old photograph lies by the bed. I recognize Qingwu, but not the person holding a lunch tin. Gu says it is a former student, seldom seen now, who sometimes brings medicine. He asks us not to show the picture around. Not everyone he knows belongs in tonight’s inquiry.
I turn it face down. Luo records that the family holds it, without automatically treating me as family. Helping someone maintain a life begins with admitting how many doors I do not know, and which drawers I should not open.

text.zh:
医生拿出几张空白纸，让顾先生自己说需要什么：早上有人陪着取药，夜里有一盏能看清门口的灯，若临时搬房，先告诉他去哪里。他说得很慢，我却发现每一件都比“我会照顾你”更具体。
剩下的是谁来做。我可以接下第一段夜班，也可以请周姨帮忙找愿意轮换的人。一个人的承诺容易说清，几个人的承诺更不容易因一次生病便全部落空；但参与的人越多，要解释和保护的事情也越多。
text.en:
Luo brings blank paper and lets Gu state his needs: company when collecting medicine, a light showing the door at night, and advance notice if he must move. He speaks slowly, yet each request is more concrete than my offer to care for him.
Who will do it? I can take the first watches, or ask Zhou to find willing helpers. One person’s promise is simpler; several people are less vulnerable to a single illness. More helpers also mean more arrangements and more privacy to protect.

text.zh: 顾先生愿意接受帮助，但不愿被搬来搬去。罗医生只能保证诊所的值班，不能替所有人承担今后的日子。你愿意怎样开始？
text.en: Gu accepts help but does not want to be moved repeatedly. Luo can cover clinic duty, not everyone’s future. How will you begin?

label.zh: 先接下自己的夜班，再逐项邀请别人轮值
label.en: Take my own watch, then invite specific help

label.zh: 只答应眼下能做的三夜，不招募别人
label.en: Promise only three nights I can cover myself

text.zh:
我写下自己能够来的三个晚上，划掉需要回单位点名的时段。承认这些限制有些难堪，却比临时消失更诚实。罗医生把剩下的空格留着，说不能为了表格好看，就把别人没有答应的名字填进去。
顾先生看完，把其中一晚的陪同改成了敲门询问。他说那天若精神好，想自己坐在窗边。空格第一次像是一种尊重，而不只是安排不周。
text.en:
I write three evenings I can attend, excluding the hours I must report at my work unit. Admitting limits is embarrassing but more honest than vanishing unexpectedly. Luo leaves the remaining spaces blank: we cannot fill them with names that have not agreed.
Gu changes one visit into a knock to ask whether he needs company. If he feels well, he wants to sit by the window alone. A blank can express respect, not simply poor planning.

text.zh:
我们约定，后弄愿意帮忙的人只领取自己承诺的那一段，不需要知道顾先生全部的病史。医生保留用药说明，顾先生决定哪些私人事情可以讲。我要去煤炉旁问取水和热饭的办法。
走到门口，他叫住我，说别为了照顾他把弟弟的事全丢下。我答应继续找，也答应不再把找不到的焦急变成要求他记起更多的理由。
text.en:
Helpers in the rear court will receive only the task they accept, not Gu’s whole medical history. Luo keeps the medicine instructions; Gu controls private disclosures. I will ask about water and hot food beside the communal stove.
At the door Gu tells me not to abandon my brother’s case for his sake. I promise to keep searching, and not use my frustration to demand more memories from him.

note.zh: 护人第一步：答应具体夜班，顾先生保留拒绝与调整的权利。下一步后弄煤炉。
note.en: Care step one: specific watches, with Gu free to refuse or revise. Next: rear-court stove.

text.zh:
我没有把未来许诺得很远，只写下三夜。顾先生点头，说三夜也是日子，不必因为不能许诺一生就看轻它。我把第四夜留空，答应三夜之后再问一次，而不是假装空格不存在。
罗医生提醒我，一个人接班时尤其要有联系不上我的办法。他不会把药物交给未经说明的人，也不会因为我说自己能撑，就把疲倦当作已经解决。
text.en:
I promise three nights rather than a distant future. Gu says three nights are still part of a life; their limit does not make them worthless. I leave the fourth blank and promise to ask again, instead of pretending there is no gap.
Luo wants a fallback if I cannot be reached. He will not leave medicine with an uninstructed helper or treat exhaustion as solved merely because I insist I can endure it.

text.zh:
我把单位的报到时间告诉医生，想到过去总怕别人知道自己的日程，如今却需要一个人知道我什么时候应该出现。顾先生把窗边那张空凳留给我，没有要求我坐满整夜。
后弄的水和煤仍要安排。留下来不是放弃一切去照顾一个人，而是在原本就拥挤的生活里找到一块确实可以交给他的时间。这条路最后会是一项有限的守候，不会突然变成已经建好的互助网。
text.en:
I tell Luo my reporting hours. Once I feared anyone knowing my schedule; now someone must know when I should arrive. Gu leaves me the window stool without asking that I occupy it all night.
Water and coal still need arranging. Staying means finding real time inside an already crowded life, not magically abandoning every obligation. This path will end with a limited watch, not a mutual-aid network we never built.

note.zh: 护人第一步：承诺三夜独立守候，不自动获得互助网结局。下一步后弄煤炉。
note.en: Care step one: three personal watches; no unearned network ending. Next: rear-court stove.

text.zh:
公用煤炉没有我想象中一直烧着。夜里各家轮流用，炉口边用粉笔写着一个个时段。周姨说，若插进一锅热水，就要有人晚一点洗衣服或热饭。小事看似不值一提，却不能因为我的事情听上去更重要，就把别人的日子推开。
我挨个询问，才知道最晚那一格原是替楼上的小孩留的。他母亲早班回来，要给他擦身。我们把顾先生的热水提前，谁也没有失去原来那一格。
text.en:
The communal stove is not kept burning all night. Chalk marks divide its use between households. An extra pot can delay someone’s washing or meal. Small needs cannot be displaced simply because my story sounds more urgent.
Only by asking do I learn that the latest slot is reserved for a child upstairs, whose mother returns from an early shift. We move Gu’s water earlier. Nobody loses their existing turn.

text.zh:
取水比安排炉火更费工。水槽到诊所要走过一段没灯的路，热水瓶的提手又松了。一个邻居教我用旧布垫住把手，周姨找出有木塞的瓶子。我把路线走了一遍，记下哪里积水，哪里门槛高，回来时才发现自己一滴水也不该洒在别人门前。
我学建筑时画过许多看起来合理的走道。今晚真正需要的，只是一条疲倦的人提着水也能走稳的路。
text.en:
Carrying water takes more work than reserving the stove. The clinic path is dark, and the flask handle is loose. A neighbor shows me a cloth grip; Zhou finds a sound stopper. I walk the route, noting puddles and thresholds, and realize I must not leave a slippery trail at another person’s door.
In architecture school I drew many plausible corridors. Tonight the useful design is simply a path a tired person can walk while carrying hot water.

text.zh:
周姨没有替所有人答应。她给愿意帮忙的人分别说了取水、送饭和敲门的事，不需要每个人都做同样多。一位邻居只能隔天把瓶子放到门口，另一位只能在我临时缺席时带一句话。
这些小小的限制让我安心了一点：他们说的是自己真的能做的事。我们没有成立什么，也没有写一份漂亮的联名书。只把谁同意了哪件事记清楚，让没有同意的人也可以平常地从炉边走过。
text.en:
Zhou does not consent on everyone’s behalf. Willing neighbors hear separate requests for water, food, or a knock at the door. One can leave a flask out every other day; another can only carry a message when I am absent.
Their limits reassure me: these are tasks they can actually do. We form no grand organization and sign no impressive joint declaration. We record specific agreements, leaving everyone else free to pass the stove without being judged.

text.zh:
煤火暗下去时，我把第三天以后的空格重新看了一遍。若我选择招募轮值，就带着已经得到的同意继续核对；若我只答应三夜，就让医生知道何时需要重新安排。没有任何一格是靠一句“总会有办法”填满的。
周姨把瓶塞压紧，叫我去候船室靠窗长凳见下一位带口信的人。那人只愿在半公开的地方谈，不愿把住址告诉陌生人。接受帮助，也要接受别人选择见面的方式。
text.en:
As the fire dims, I review the gaps after the third day. If I invited a rota, I must verify the agreements received. If I promised only three nights, Luo must know when another arrangement is needed. “Something will work out” fills no space.
Zhou tightens the flask stopper and directs me to the ferry hall window bench. A messenger prefers a public meeting and will not give a stranger their address. Accepting help includes accepting how someone chooses to meet.

note.zh: 后弄：热水时段、搬运路线与有限轮值已落实。下一步候船室靠窗长凳。
note.en: Rear court: water slot, carrying route, and limited help arranged. Next: ferry hall window bench.

text.zh:
长凳上坐着一个手里攥着布包的人。她说不必知道她与顾先生的关系，只要知道她愿意明早送一次早饭。我没有追问。她先看见我手里的轮值表，问上面为什么留那么多空格。
我把每个空格解释给她听：未同意、时间未定、或顾先生希望独处。她听完，把自己那一格改成了“先敲门”。一张表终于开始记录一个人的生活，而不只是记录我们想为他做多少事。
text.en:
A woman on the bench holds a cloth parcel. I need not know how she knows Gu, only that she will bring breakfast tomorrow. I do not press. She asks why the schedule has so many blanks.
I explain: no agreement yet, an uncertain time, or Gu’s wish for solitude. She changes her entry to “knock first.” The schedule begins to record a person’s life instead of measuring how much we want to do for him.

text.zh:
她问，如果第二天顾先生不肯开门，是否要立刻把人叫来。我想起自己一年里有多少次听见敲门便屏住呼吸，没有把沉默简单写成出事。医生的说明区分了普通拒绝、约定后的失联和需要立即求助的情况。
我把说明读给她听，请她复述一遍，不是考她，而是检查我有没有说清楚。她漏掉一句，我也发现自己抄漏了医生留下的联系办法。好在这张长凳上的核对发生在真正需要它之前。
text.en:
She asks whether a closed door tomorrow means she should immediately summon people. Remembering how often a knock made me hold my breath, I do not equate silence with disaster. Luo distinguishes ordinary refusal, an unexplained missed agreement, and an urgent need for help.
I read his instructions and ask her to repeat them, to check my explanation rather than test her. She misses a line; I discover I omitted Luo’s contact instructions. We are fortunate to catch this on a bench before anyone needs them.

text.zh:
布包里是两只碗，不是药，也不是钱。她说旧碗边缘有缺口，顾先生手不稳，换一只好拿的比劝他多喝水有用。我忽然明白，照顾有时不是增加一句温柔的话，而是撤掉一件让人每天都要费力的东西。
我把碗收下，给她一张写着接收日期的小纸。她笑我太郑重，却还是折好放进口袋。有人愿意记得她交出了什么，这件事也并不多余。
text.en:
The parcel contains two bowls, not medicine or money. Gu’s old bowl has a chipped rim; with unsteady hands, a better grip helps more than advice to drink enough. Care sometimes means removing a small daily difficulty rather than adding another kind sentence.
I accept them and write a dated receipt. She smiles at the formality but keeps it. Remembering what someone contributed is not entirely unnecessary.

text.zh:
天色未亮，第一顿早饭已经有了去处。我没有从这件小事里看见对往后的保证，却看见一条可以在出错时及时询问的路。若轮值已经得到同意，问讯窗口可以替大家寄存一份只写时段的表；若只有我的三夜，就留下我自己的交接说明。
我站起来时，布包比文件沉。寻找弟弟的事情仍在，过去的错误也不会被一只碗抵消。只是今夜以后，我不必再把“没有找到答案”理解成“什么也不能做”。
text.en:
Before dawn, the first breakfast has a destination. It promises no safe future, but offers a way to ask when something goes wrong. If the rota has consent, the enquiry window can hold a copy listing times only. If I have promised three nights alone, it can hold my personal handover note.
The bowls weigh more than the papers. My brother remains missing; a bowl cannot cancel past mistakes. Yet not finding an answer no longer means there is nothing I can do.

note.zh: 护人三步完成。到问讯窗口，决定守候三夜或交接互助轮值。
note.en: Care tasks complete. At the enquiry window, choose personal watches or the agreed rota.

text.zh:
我决定先为离开作准备。船票只到对岸，后面的路仍要自己走。我得回旧屋床脚收拾皮箱，再到货栈待运木箱处交代留下的材料，最后去候船室靠窗长凳核对接应地址。
离开不会替我撤销对任何人的承诺，也不能证明我比留下的人更清醒。只有把这些事一件件办完，登船才不只是从一个恐惧里逃进另一个想象。
text.en:
I begin preparing to leave. The ticket reaches only the far bank; the journey beyond remains mine. I must pack the suitcase at home, hand over materials beside the warehouse outbound crate, and verify a contact at the ferry hall window bench.
Leaving cancels no promise and proves no superiority over those staying. Only by doing these tasks can boarding become more than escaping one fear into another imagined place.

text.zh:
皮箱打开时，箱底的樟脑味比记忆里重。十一年前装满书的地方，如今放着几张没画完的住宅图。最早一张上，我给每户都画了朝南的窗，却没有想过谁有权决定一个人最后住在哪间房里。
我把图纸展开，折痕已经脆了。带走它们，是保存过去的自己，还是给路上的人添一件必须解释的东西？箱子只有这么大，凡是装进去的，都要由接下来的身体背着走。
text.en:
The opened suitcase smells strongly of mothballs. Where books lay eleven years ago are unfinished housing drawings. On the earliest, every family has a south-facing window. I had not asked who could decide which room a person must finally occupy.
The folds are brittle. Would carrying them preserve my former self or add another object requiring explanation? Space is limited. Whatever I pack must be carried by the body taking the next road.

text.zh:
抽屉最底下有母亲记下的亲戚住址。其中一户在对岸，更远一户在南方，最后一次来信都是几年前。我不能把一个旧地址当作已经张开的门。那家人也许搬走，也许同样受着盘问，也许只是无力再添一副碗筷。
我把需要核对的事写在背面：人是否仍住在那里，是否愿意见我，若不能收留，是否可以代收一封回信。三个问题不是同一个问题，不能只得到其中一个答复就把另外两个也当作答应。
text.en:
At the drawer’s bottom are addresses in my mother’s handwriting: one across the river, another farther south. Their last letters are years old. An old address is not an open door. They may have moved, face questioning themselves, or simply lack room at the table.
I list separate questions: do they still live there, will they see me, and if they cannot host me, will they receive a letter? Answering one does not answer the others.

text.zh:
合影要放在皮箱里还是贴身带着，我想了很久。顾先生已经看过它，记起了青芜；原件却还是家里的东西，不属于我一个人的痛苦。我在背面写下今夜离开的日期，又停笔，划掉“离开”，改成“准备出门”。
事情没有发生之前，不该先替它写一个完成时。接下来我要决定是否沿旧地址核对远行的可能，或把这张渡票只当作一次过江后再回来的路。两条路都需要诚实地告诉别人，我能够答应什么。
text.en:
I hesitate over whether the photograph belongs in the case or close to my body. Gu has seen it and remembered Qingwu, but the original belongs to a household, not solely to my grief. I write tonight’s date on the back, then replace “departed” with “preparing to go.”
An event deserves no past tense before it happens. I must decide whether to verify the old address for a longer journey or treat the crossing as something from which I may return. Either route requires honest promises.

text.zh: 母亲的地址簿和诊所给的渡票摆在一起。你可以核对远方接应，准备真正离开；也可以只收拾一个轻包，不把未经确认的住处写成未来。
text.en: Mother’s address book lies beside the ferry ticket. You can verify a contact and prepare to travel farther, or pack lightly without turning an unconfirmed home into a promised future.

label.zh: 带上地址簿，逐项核对远行条件
label.en: Take the address book and verify the onward journey

label.zh: 只带过江所需，保留回来照看的打算
label.en: Pack for the crossing and keep a plan to return

text.zh:
我把地址簿夹在信封里，没有把亲戚的名字写到箱盖上。两件换洗衣服、一小包干粮、图纸中的一张，最后才是那几份无法轻易替代的材料。其他东西留在原处，我给周姨写了一张清单，注明哪些可以动，哪些要等我回来再说。
清单让“以后”变得具体，也让我不能假装离开只涉及自己的身体。一个空下来的房间仍然需要有人知道钥匙在哪里。
text.en:
I slip the address book into an envelope rather than write a relative’s name on the case. Clothes, food, one drawing, then the hard-to-replace papers go inside. For Zhou I list what may be moved and what should await my return.
The list gives substance to “later.” Departure involves more than my body. An empty room still needs someone to know where its key is.

text.zh:
我把备用钥匙放在周姨约定的位置，没有因为她曾经替我保管旧屋，就默认她愿意再保管一年。信里写着若她不便，可以把钥匙交回诊所转告我。
出门前我对着屋里说了一声“走了”。没有人回答。这一次，我没有把安静理解成房子已经原谅我。接下来到货栈待运木箱，安排不能带走的纸。
text.en:
I leave the spare key where Zhou agreed, without assuming that past help obliges her to another year. My note provides a way to return it through the clinic if necessary.
I say goodbye to the room. Nothing answers. I do not mistake the silence for forgiveness. Next is the warehouse outbound crate, where I must arrange the papers I cannot carry.

note.zh: 离沪第一步：带地址簿核对接应，留房屋交接单。下一步货栈待运木箱。
note.en: Departure step one: verify the address; leave a house handover. Next: warehouse outbound crate.

text.zh:
我没有拿走地址簿，只抄了对岸那一处的门牌，注明“尚未核实”。皮箱太重，我改用布包，装一件衣服和今晚的材料。周姨见到包的时候问我是不是还会回来，我没有为了让她宽心而马上点头。
我说先过江看看，若没有可靠的去处，就回来把房子与下一步安排清楚。她不喜欢这个不确定的回答，却没有再替我补上一个更好听的承诺。
text.en:
I leave the address book, copying only the near-bank contact and marking it unverified. The suitcase is too heavy; a cloth bag holds one shirt and the papers. Zhou asks whether I will return. I do not nod merely to comfort her.
I will cross and assess matters. Without a reliable destination, I will return to settle the house and next steps. She dislikes the uncertainty but does not supply a prettier promise for me.

text.zh:
我把没有拿走的东西摆回原来的位置，像给一个可能回来的自己留路。不是所有犹豫都该被叫作懦弱；有时只是终于不肯把一张票当成整个人生的答案。
货栈还有该交代的材料。即使只离开一段时间，我也不能让别人不知道这些纸去了哪里。我把布包系紧，没有把门锁死两遍。
text.en:
I replace what I leave behind, keeping a path for a self who may return. Not every hesitation is cowardice. Sometimes it means refusing to make one ticket answer an entire life.
Even a short absence requires explaining where the papers will go. I tie the bag securely and lock the door once, not twice.

note.zh: 离沪第一步：只准备短程过江，保留返回计划。下一步货栈待运木箱。
note.en: Departure step one: a short crossing with a return plan. Next: warehouse outbound crate.

text.zh:
待运木箱上写着不同人家的姓，字迹有新有旧。工人问我哪一件要托运，我把皮箱拉回脚边，说先来问规矩。他指着台面上的条款：货物会经过几次转手，没有人替私人物件保证随时可取。
我原以为把东西交给一个更大的系统，就能少担心一些。看着条款才明白，少看见一件东西的过程，并不等于它的过程就变得可靠。弟弟的旧信已经替我上过这一课。
text.en:
The outbound crates bear family names in old and new ink. A worker asks what I am consigning. I keep the bag at my feet and ask the terms first. Cargo changes hands repeatedly; nobody promises that private belongings can be retrieved whenever needed.
I had thought a larger system would relieve my worry. Not seeing an object’s journey does not make that journey reliable. My brother’s old letter has already taught me this.

text.zh:
林岚带来一张薄纸，要我分清哪些带走、哪些留下、哪些只带索引。我不能让所有证据只跟着同一只箱子走，也不能在没有问过的情况下把她的证言寄往一个她不认识的地址。
我们逐条核对，她允许我携带的是关于印刷过程的节录，未公开的姓名继续留在原处。医生的部分也是如此。我带走的仍能说明疑点，只是不能再冒称自己有权把整座弄堂的人都交给远方阅读。
text.en:
Lin brings a sheet for separating what travels, what stays, and what is represented only by an index. Everything cannot depend on one case. Nor may I send her account to an unknown address without permission.
She agrees to an extract about printing; undisclosed names remain here. Luo’s account receives the same care. What I carry still supports questions, but does not give me authority to send an entire neighborhood to distant readers.

text.zh:
工人给我的不是一张能够保证抵达的凭证，而是一张说明接收了什么的凭证。我把这句话读了两遍，觉得它与档案室的名册很像。纸记录一个环节，不自动替下一环负责。
我选择把最难替代的材料留在贴身包里，其余交给已经同意的保管人。收据写清日期与页数，内容只写“私人纸件”。林岚留下一份，叮嘱我如果改道，也要设法让她知道。
text.en:
The worker’s receipt certifies what was received, not that it will arrive. It resembles the archive register: a record of one stage does not guarantee the next.
Irreplaceable papers stay close to me. Others go to agreed keepers. The receipt specifies date and page count, describing the contents only as private papers. Lin keeps a copy and asks for word if I change course.

text.zh:
我曾把离开想成身后的一切突然安静。现在要写的交接比打包还多：旧屋的钥匙、分存的页数、亲戚可能拒绝接应的备用安排。每写一项，都有一个活人的位置出现在纸上。
货栈的木箱仍在等装车，我没有把自己的包放进去。去候船室靠窗长凳见带口信的人，是下一步。对岸是否有门会开，必须由门里的人来回答。
text.en:
I once imagined departure as everything behind me falling silent. The handover now takes longer than packing: the house key, stored page counts, a fallback if relatives decline. Each line makes space for a living person.
The crates await loading. My bag stays with me. Next I meet the messenger on the ferry hall window bench. Only the person behind a door can say whether it will open.

note.zh: 货栈交接完成：关键纸件随身，其余按约寄存。下一步候船室靠窗长凳。
note.en: Warehouse handover complete: essential papers stay with me; others in agreed custody. Next: ferry hall window bench.

text.zh:
带口信的人没有递来一封欢迎信，只说那户人家还住在原处，愿意让我先去敲门。他不知道能不能留宿，更不知道我最后想去哪里。我感谢他把不知道说得清楚。
过去一年，我常常拿别人一句含糊的安慰替自己编出一整段未来。现在桌上只有今晚这张船票、一个未必接纳的门牌和我能够独自承担的路程。东西少了一些，轮廓却清楚了。
text.en:
The messenger brings no welcome letter. The household remains at the address and permits a knock; he cannot promise lodging or know my eventual destination. I thank him for clearly stating what he does not know.
For a year I built whole futures from vague reassurance. Now there is tonight’s ticket, a door that may not offer shelter, and a distance I can undertake myself. The inventory is smaller and clearer.

text.zh:
我把到对岸以后的顺序写在票背：先确认能否暂住，再问是否可代收信，最后才谈南下。若第一步失败，就回到渡口，不去另一个从未约好的家门前把自己的困境变成他们的责任。
长凳上的人说，很多人走的时候都只问最后一段路，把中间那些必须吃饭、睡觉、解释来历的日子忘了。我没有反驳。我在国外读过书，也仍然需要从一顿饭和一处能坐下的地方开始。
text.en:
On the ticket back I list the order: ask about temporary lodging, ask about receiving mail, then discuss farther travel. If the first fails, return to the ferry rather than arrive uninvited elsewhere and make my need their obligation.
People often ask only about the final destination, the messenger says, forgetting the meals, sleep, and explanations in between. I have studied abroad, yet still need to begin with food and somewhere to sit.

text.zh:
汽笛响时，我忽然很想把皮箱丢在这里，轻轻松松走上船。可包里有别人信任我的部分，也有我答应带回来消息的地址。轻装不该靠假装这些事不存在。
我给周姨写了一张短笺，交到约定转交的位置：不写“我已经安全”，只写接下来准备怎样联系。若我最后改变主意留在上海，也要回来取走这张短笺，免得让一个人对着并未发生的离别等信。
text.en:
At the horn I want to abandon the bag and board unburdened. But it contains trust and addresses to which I promised news. Travelling lightly cannot depend on pretending those obligations vanished.
I leave Zhou a note at the agreed forwarding point. It describes how I plan to contact her, not that I am already safe. If I remain in Shanghai, I must retrieve it rather than leave someone waiting on a departure that never happened.

text.zh:
候船窗已经亮起灯，问讯的人在清理台面。我仍可以把过江当作真正离开的第一步，前提是准备已经做过；也可以收回给周姨的短笺，走回里弄，在更清楚自己处境以后重新安排明天。
哪一种都不能抹去今晚的调查。不同的是，这些材料接下来由一个远行的人携带，还是由一个决定暂留的人继续核对。我站起来，才发现自己一直握着船票，票角已被汗浸软。
text.en:
The enquiry window is lit. I can make the crossing the first step of a longer departure, if I have prepared for that journey. Or I can retrieve Zhou’s note and return to the lane, making tomorrow’s arrangements with clearer knowledge.
Neither choice erases tonight’s inquiry. The difference is whether a traveler carries the record onward or someone staying continues to check it. I stand and discover the ticket’s corner has softened in my hand.

note.zh: 离沪三步完成。去问讯窗口选择登船继续远行，或退票回到里弄。
note.en: Departure tasks complete. At the enquiry window: board for the onward journey, or cancel and return.

text.zh:
我说自己已经承受不住再让更多人卷进来。没有人因此叫我懦夫，林岚也没有替我宽恕一切。她只问：准备沉默到哪一步，哪些东西是我的，哪些仍属于别人？
我得先回档案室看更正表，再到旧屋皮箱旁整理未寄出的信，最后在候船室靠窗长凳向帮助过我的人交代。这条路不会靠一把火立刻结束。即使停止追查，已经说过的话仍然需要有人负责。
text.en:
I say I cannot bear drawing more people into this. Nobody calls me a coward; Lin does not forgive everything on their behalf. She asks how far I intend silence to go, and which papers are mine to dispose of.
I must examine the archive correction forms, sort the unsent letter beside the suitcase at home, then explain myself on the ferry hall window bench. A flame will not finish this route instantly. Even stopping leaves responsibility for words already spoken.

text.zh:
更正表的纸比名册新，边角没有翻阅留下的黑色。上面留着几栏：原记载、拟更正、理由、经手人。只要填好，就能让后来查档的人先看见另一种说法。我把笔拿起来，又放下。
我想撤回的是自己愿意继续追查的承诺，并不是已经看见的事实。两者如果混写在一张表上，下一次来找沈泊的人可能连今晚这条断断续续的路都走不到。
text.en:
The correction forms are newer than the register, their corners unworn. They provide boxes for the original entry, amendment, reason, and handler. Once completed, a future reader would encounter a different account first. I lift the pen, then set it down.
I want to withdraw my promise to investigate, not the facts I have seen. Combining those actions could erase even this broken route for the next person looking for Shen Bo.

text.zh:
一份废弃的更正表夹在下面，把“未收到回执”改成了“已办结”。我不知道这张表最后有没有生效，也不愿再凭一张草稿替一个陌生人定罪。但那两个词让我感到寒冷：事情可以没有答案，手续却可以已经结束。
我在空纸上写了自己的范围：不再主动传递个人抄本，不要求他人代我追问，不改动原始名册。写到第三条，才发现它不是对自己的保护，而是给一个以后可能来到这里的人留下一点东西。
text.en:
An abandoned form changes “receipt not received” to “case completed.” I do not know whether it took effect, and will not condemn a stranger on a draft alone. The words chill me: a question can remain unanswered while its paperwork is finished.
On separate paper I limit my withdrawal: stop circulating my copies, stop asking others to inquire for me, leave the original register untouched. The third rule protects a future visitor more than it protects me.

text.zh:
林岚进来时没有劝我重新勇敢，只把我借走的页码逐一核对。她要知道我是否准备连她自己的记录也一并毁掉。我说没有权这样做。她点头，却没有笑。
停止调查不能使已经承担的危险全部消失，也不能让别人失去继续保留自身记忆的权利。我能决定的，是我亲手写下的那份未寄陈述。它是交给火，还是封起来暂时不递，必须在回旧屋之前想清楚。
text.en:
Lin does not urge courage. She checks the page numbers I borrowed, asking whether I intend to destroy her own record as well. I have no right to do that. She nods without smiling.
Stopping cannot erase every risk already taken or remove another person’s right to retain a memory. What I control is my own unsent statement. Before returning home, I must decide whether it is to be destroyed or sealed without delivery.

text.zh: 桌上只有你自己写的陈述，不包含名册原件、医生证言或林岚的记录。毁去它会失去一份可以重读的自述；封存它则意味着将来仍可能需要面对纸上的问题。
text.en: Only your own statement lies here, not the original register, Luo’s testimony, or Lin’s record. Destroying it removes an account you could revisit. Sealing it leaves the possibility of facing its questions later.

label.zh: 准备销毁自己的陈述，保留他人的原件
label.en: Prepare to destroy my statement; preserve others’ originals

label.zh: 保留一份封存草稿，暂不递交
label.en: Keep a sealed draft without submitting it

text.zh:
我把待销毁的页码另列一张清单。写清哪些是自己的话，才知道过去有多少句看似属于我的指控，其实只是听来的。我一页页删去转述，没有把它们当作证据再复制一次。
林岚把属于她的那部分收回，说会自己决定怎样保管。她没有答应替我忘记今晚，也没有权替其他人答应。我的决定缩回到它实际能够触及的大小：几张纸，一个人。
text.en:
I list the pages intended for destruction. Separating my words reveals how many apparent accusations were merely things I heard. I remove those repetitions instead of reproducing them as evidence.
Lin takes back her portion and will decide its custody herself. She promises neither to forget tonight nor to speak for everyone else. My decision becomes its actual size: several pages, one person.

text.zh:
回旧屋前，我把空白更正表放回搁板。没有填上“已办结”，也没有补写一个并不存在的解释。名册仍然留在原处，缺失的回执仍然缺失。
我不知道这算不算最后一点坚持。也许只是终于不愿为了让自己的日子容易过些，就替弟弟的下落编一个足够整齐的结尾。皮箱旁还有未寄出的家信，需要分清哪些话可以烧，哪些属于我还欠着的回答。
text.en:
I replace the blank correction form. No “completed” stamp, no invented explanation. The register remains where it was; its missing receipt stays missing.
Perhaps this is a last small stand, or merely a refusal to invent a tidy fate for my brother to make my life easier. Beside the suitcase waits a family letter. I still need to distinguish words I may destroy from answers I owe.

note.zh: 缄默第一步：只销毁自己的陈述，不改原档。下一步旧屋皮箱。
note.en: Silence step one: only my own statement may be destroyed; the archive stays intact. Next: home suitcase.

text.zh:
我在草稿封面写“未递”，不写“作废”。里面有尚未证实的猜测，我用不同的线标出，免得后来的人误把一时的愤怒当成已经核对过的结论。封口日期是今晚，不是假装事情从未发生的某个过去。
林岚问我是否希望她替我保管。我说先留在自己能找到的地方，若以后转交，会重新征求她同意。不能把迟疑也无声地托付给别人。
text.en:
I write “not submitted,” not “void.” I mark unverified guesses distinctly so a later reader will not mistake anger for a checked conclusion. The sealing date is tonight, not an invented earlier time pretending nothing happened.
Lin offers custody. I will first keep it somewhere I can find and ask again if that changes. I cannot silently make another person responsible even for my hesitation.

text.zh:
名册原件留在桌上，封存草稿回到我的口袋。此刻我没有决定什么时候再打开，只决定不给未来的自己伪造一个从未知道这些事的过去。
走出档案室时，我仍然害怕。保留纸并没有让我比准备烧纸的人高明；它只多留下一种可能，也多留下一份需要承担的风险。接下来回旧屋皮箱旁，把没寄出的家信写完。
text.en:
The register stays; the sealed draft returns to my pocket. I set no date to reopen it. I only refuse to give my future self a fabricated past in which I never knew these things.
I remain afraid. Keeping a page makes me no wiser than someone destroying one. It preserves a possibility and a risk. Next I return to the suitcase and finish the unsent family letter.

note.zh: 缄默第一步：保留标注疑点的封存草稿。下一步旧屋皮箱。
note.en: Silence step one: preserve a sealed draft with uncertainties marked. Next: home suitcase.

text.zh:
旧屋的门比来时容易推开，也许只是木头被雨气泡软了。皮箱旁的抽屉里有一封我写给弟弟却没寄的信，开头竟是在问他为什么把事情弄成这样。我坐下来，读完了自己曾经准备寄出去的责怪。
当时我已经知道他被带走，却还把没有回信看作一种故意的沉默。我想把整封信撕掉，好像这样就能使那个轻易相信传言的自己也不存在。纸的纤维在指间绷紧，我终于还是松开了手。
text.en:
The door opens more easily, perhaps only because rain has swollen the wood. In the drawer is a letter I never sent my brother. It begins by asking why he made such a mess. I sit and read the blame I once intended to mail.
I knew he had been taken away, yet treated no reply as a deliberate silence. I want to tear up the letter, as though that could erase the self who believed rumors. The fibers tighten between my hands. I let go.

text.zh:
我另拿一张纸，把今晚知道的写给他：名字怎样被补印，转出与抵达为什么不是一回事，旧信怎样在几处地方迟迟没有被送到。写到最后，我仍没有地址可以把它寄出去。
接着是更难写的一句：我曾经怪过你。没有解释自己也是多么害怕，没有在后面接一个“但是”。如果有一天这封信能到他手里，他有权不立即原谅；如果永远到不了，也不该因此变成一封只求让我好受些的信。
text.en:
On a new sheet I tell him what tonight established: the added name, the difference between transfer and arrival, and the places where his letter waited. I still have no address to send it to.
Then comes the harder sentence: I blamed you. I add neither an account of my own fear nor a “but.” If the letter reaches him, he may refuse immediate forgiveness. If it never does, it still should not exist merely to soothe me.

text.zh:
家信与调查陈述终于分开。前者是我欠弟弟的话，后者是准备交给外界查阅的材料；不能因为害怕后者，就把前者也归入必须消失的一堆。母亲曾把不同人的信分别扎好，我第一次理解那不只是爱整齐。
我用旧棉线把家信系起，放在合影后面。是否保留调查草稿，照档案室作出的选择办理。旧屋里没有人替我监督，决定仍然需要在这里算数。
text.en:
The family letter and investigative statement are finally separate. One contains words I owe my brother; the other was prepared for outside readers. Fear of the latter need not make the former disappear. Mother tied different people’s letters in separate bundles. I begin to understand why.
I tie the family letter behind the photograph. The investigative draft follows my archive decision. No one is here to enforce it; the decision must still mean something.

text.zh:
窗外有人收起晾衣绳，木夹落在盆里，声音清楚得像小时候。那时我以为屋里关上门，外面的事便会远些。如今才知道，关门只能决定谁暂时进来，不能决定已经发生的事还算不算发生过。
我得去候船室靠窗长凳，把停下来的打算告诉帮助过我的人。不是请他们批准，也不是索要宽慰，而是不让他们继续按一个我已经撤回的承诺等下去。
text.en:
Outside, clothes pegs fall into a basin with a sound from childhood. I once thought closing a door pushed the outside world away. A door can limit who enters for a while; it cannot decide whether the past happened.
At the ferry hall window bench I must tell those who helped that I am stopping. I need neither permission nor comfort, but must not let them keep waiting on a promise I have withdrawn.

note.zh: 旧屋：家信与调查草稿分开；不把停查变成否认事实。下一步候船室靠窗长凳。
note.en: Home: family letter separated from the investigative draft. Stopping is not denying facts. Next: ferry hall window bench.

text.zh:
林岚听完没有立即回答。候船室里有人在扫地，扫帚每次经过长凳底下，我们都要把脚抬起来。这个小动作重复了几次，她才说她不准备停止保管自己的记录。
我点头，没有把她的坚持听成对我的指责。她也没有把我的退出解释成所有证据都变得不可信。我们第一次在同一张长凳上明确承认，可以经历同一夜，却不走同一条路。
text.en:
Lin listens without answering. A cleaner passes the broom under the bench; we lift our feet several times before she says she will keep her own record.
I do not take her persistence as an accusation. She does not treat my withdrawal as proof the evidence is worthless. We can have lived through the same night without taking the same road.

text.zh:
我把她交给我的查阅约定归还，逐条说明已经告诉过谁、哪些纸从未离开过口袋。她最关心的不是我是否愿意继续，而是别人是否还会以为她同意公开所有名字。
我们把范围重新写清。罗医生仍然保管病人的记录，周姨仍可收留家信，没有一项权利因我害怕便被收回。我的沉默只能属于我自己，不能变成要求他们一起闭口的命令。
text.en:
I return Lin’s access agreements and specify whom I contacted and which papers never left my pocket. Her chief concern is whether others might still believe she consented to every name being published.
We clarify the limits. Luo retains patient records; Zhou may still keep family letters. My fear revokes none of their rights. My silence belongs to me; it cannot become an order for everyone else to be silent.

text.zh:
她问我是否需要把已经准备的寄存通知撤回。我说需要，至少不能让一个陌生人替我等一只永远不会送来的封套。问讯窗口可以记下取消托交，原件的位置不必写进去。
我想到最初那封迟到的信。有人多写清楚一行，后来的人也许就能少等一段时间。即使选择停止，我仍能做这件很小的事。它不会挽救整段人生，却可以避免我再制造一个新的误会。
text.en:
She asks whether to cancel pending custody notices. Yes: no stranger should wait for a folder that will never arrive. The enquiry window can record the cancellation without learning where the originals are.
A clear extra line might once have shortened the wait for my brother’s letter. Even stopping, I can avoid creating a new misunderstanding. That will not redeem a whole life, but it remains worth doing.

text.zh:
我把最后的安排带到窗口前。若准备销毁，只能销毁自己有权处置的陈述，不能借着一阵火替别人决定遗忘；若保留了草稿，可以封存未寄，不再声称自己已经递出它。
外面仍有船在走。没有一班替我带来确定的消息。今晚快结束了，害怕没有结束。我能选择的，是害怕以后怎样生活，而不是让害怕证明所有努力从一开始就不值得。
text.en:
At the window I carry the final arrangement. Destruction can cover only my own statement, not another person’s right to remember. If I retained a draft, I may seal it undelivered without pretending it has been submitted.
Boats still move outside. None brings certainty. The night is ending; fear is not. I can decide how to live after fear, rather than let fear prove nothing was ever worth doing.

note.zh: 缄默三步完成。到问讯窗口取消托交，再处理自己的陈述。
note.en: Silence tasks complete. At the enquiry window, cancel forwarding and settle your statement.

text.zh: 问讯员只肯替我们存一个查阅办法，不肯替内容作保证。我可以让有条件查阅的署名页随目录留下，也可以把身份继续封住，只留足够找到原件的路径。两种结尾都需要寄存人的约定继续有效。
text.en: The clerk will hold access instructions, not guarantee the contents. I may leave the restricted signature page with the index, or keep identities sealed and preserve only a path to the originals. Both depend on the keepers’ agreements.

label.zh: 按署名约定留下可追问的名字
label.en: Leave a name that readers may question

label.zh: 继续匿名封存，留下核对路径
label.en: Keep identities sealed and preserve the trail

text.zh:
问讯员把说明读了两遍，要求我删去一句“可证明全部经过”。我照做。这份纸将来可能经过不耐烦的人、不相信我的人，甚至根本不愿接下去读的人；它不能因此先把不确定的部分写成确定。
署名页进了内封，外面只有查阅条件和联系办法。我的名字终于再次出现在一份与自己有关的材料上，这次它没有替任何别人作答。
text.en:
The clerk asks me to remove “establishes the entire sequence.” I do. Future readers may be impatient, skeptical, or unwilling to continue. That cannot justify converting uncertainty into certainty in advance.
The signed page goes inside, with access terms outside. My name appears on a document concerning me again. This time it answers for nobody else.

text.zh:
天将亮时，林岚来取另一份目录。她没有和我握手庆祝，只问保管人若搬家，该去哪里找新的联系方式。我把那一栏指给她看，又把遗漏的第二个转交办法补上。
我们仍然不知道沈泊在哪里，也没有得到洗清一切的保证。只是从今以后，若有人愿意问，那些疑问不必再从一封没有回信的信开始。
text.en:
Near dawn Lin collects the second index. Instead of celebrating, she asks where to get new contact details if a keeper moves. I show her, then add a missing backup.
We still do not know where Shen Bo is. Nothing guarantees vindication. But another inquiry need not begin from a letter without a reply.

text.zh:
回去时我经过后弄，没有敲那些收下封套的门。答应过的检视日期还没到，他们也该有一段不被我的事情占据的清晨。我在手记末尾写下自己的名字，旁边是下一次核对的日期。
留名没有使夜色一下子退去。它只是让将来的追问找到一个愿意回答“这一部分是我核对的，其余我还不知道”的人。
text.en:
I pass the rear court without knocking. The agreed inspection date has not arrived; the keepers deserve a morning not occupied by my case. I put my name beside the next verification date.
Leaving a name does not dispel the dark. It gives a future question someone willing to answer: I checked this part; the rest I do not yet know.

text.zh:
我把署名页继续封在里面，或在尚未署名的位置保留空白。问讯员只收到编号与查阅步骤。他提醒我，匿名材料可能被搁置很久，甚至始终没有人愿意承认收到。
我没有把这句话当作劝退。决定不公开身份以后，就不能又要求它拥有公开作证的全部力量。林岚留下原件索引，至少让等待不是完全没有方向。
text.en:
The signature stays sealed, or its space remains blank. The clerk receives only references and access steps. Anonymous material may wait a long time, perhaps without acknowledgment.
I accept that consequence. Concealing identity cannot demand all the power of public testimony. Lin leaves the source index so the waiting retains a direction.

text.zh:
后弄的人按约收下第二份目录，只在我的收条上画了自己的代号。那一小笔不证明他们赞同我所有判断，只说明曾经接过这件东西。我们没有把这些不同的意思混在一起。
我把收条放在弟弟的信后面。今夜没有一个名字被我替别人补上，也没有一处不知道被写成已经查清。纸因此显得不够完整，却留出了后来的人继续工作的地方。
text.en:
A keeper receives the second index and marks the receipt with an agreed sign. It acknowledges custody, not agreement with every conclusion. We keep those meanings separate.
I place it behind my brother’s letter. No name was added on someone else’s behalf, and no unknown declared resolved. The record looks incomplete, leaving room for another reader’s work.

text.zh:
几年以后，是否会有人按编号找到这只封套，我不能预知。清晨的水槽边，有人照常洗碗，封套就在离水声很近的地方，被仔细垫高了一寸。
我仍在这座城市里，没有恢复原来的职位，也没有得到一个能大声讲述的胜利。只是有一份不署名的记录，暂时没有消失。
text.en:
I cannot know whether anyone will follow the reference years from now. At dawn someone washes dishes by the sink. Nearby, the folder is carefully raised an inch above the damp.
I remain in the city without my old position or a victory to announce. For now, an unsigned record has not disappeared.

text.zh: 问讯窗口可以保存一份不含病史的交接表。你可以回诊所开始自己答应的三夜，也可以在已取得轮值同意的前提下，把这份安排交给几个人共同接续。
text.en: The window can hold a handover without medical details. You may begin your promised watches at the clinic, or, if the rota has been agreed, entrust its continuation to several people.

label.zh: 回诊所，守好自己答应的三夜
label.en: Return to the clinic for my promised watches

label.zh: 交接已同意的轮值，让帮助能够接续

text.zh:
我在表上圈出自己的三夜，余下的格子保持原样，没有为了让结尾好看就把它们填满。问讯员把联系说明收好，说若我临时来不了，必须照上面写的办法通知。
回诊所的路上，热水瓶有些重。我停下换手，第一次允许自己在答应帮忙以后仍然觉得累。能承认累，才知道什么时候该请人替一下。
text.en:
I circle my three watches, leaving other spaces unchanged rather than filling them for a pleasing conclusion. The clerk stores the contact note and reminds me to follow it if I cannot come.
On the way back the flask grows heavy. I stop to switch hands. Admitting tiredness after promising help lets me recognize when to ask for relief.

text.zh:
顾先生见我进门，问今天是哪一天。我告诉他，又把日期写在能看见的纸上。他没有立即想起青芜，也没有因为我留下就变成一个完整恢复的人。我们坐了一会，他说水温刚好。
我把旧碗换下，窗帘留出他要求的缝。没有戏剧性的答案到来，只有几件先前说过的小事，被照着做了一遍。
text.en:
Gu asks the date. I tell him and write it where he can see. He neither immediately remembers Qingwu nor becomes restored because I stayed. After a while he says the water is the right temperature.
I replace the chipped bowl and leave the curtain gap he requested. No dramatic answer arrives. Several small agreed things are done.

text.zh:
第三夜结束以后，我还要重新问他，也要重新看自己的日程。留下是一件需要不断确认的事，不是今晚的一次选择替所有以后签好名。
手记里关于弟弟的那几页没有合上。我把灯往顾先生看得见的地方移了些，等天亮后，再继续写自己不知道的部分。
text.en:
After the third night I must ask again and check my own schedule. Staying requires renewed agreement, not one decision signing for every future day.
The pages about my brother remain open. I move the lamp where Gu can see it. After dawn I will continue recording what I do not know.

text.zh:
轮值表交出去之前，我逐个读回已经得到的答复。没有答应的名字仍然不在上面，愿意退出的人也有清楚的办法。问讯员只保留联络纸，不保存病史。
我忽然担心这样的安排太松散，周姨却说，能让人退出的帮助，才值得请别人进入。她把自己负责的那一小格折进围裙口袋。
text.en:
Before handing over the rota, I read back each agreement. Unasked names remain absent, and there is a clear way to withdraw. The clerk stores contacts, not medical histories.
I worry the arrangement is too loose. Zhou says help that permits departure is help worth inviting people into. She folds her small part into her apron pocket.

text.zh:
第一个替班的人迟到了，不是什么背叛，只是家里水壶漏了。我们按约捎去口信，调换了热水时段。安排第一次出错，也第一次没有因为一个人缺席就全部垮掉。
顾先生听见门外说话，让我们别把轮值当作一件比吃饭还大的事。我答应把表放低一点，不让每次抬头都先看见自己的名字被谁照看着。
text.en:
The first relief helper is late because a kettle leaked. We send the agreed message and swap water slots. The plan fails once without collapsing around one absence.
Gu asks us not to make the rota more important than his meals. I move the chart lower so he need not see a record of supervision every time he looks up.

text.zh:
我终于能腾出一个上午继续查弟弟的事，也能按时回来接自己的班。没有谁接过别人全部的人生，只有几个人把力所能及的一小段接在一起。
煤炉旁的粉笔字会被擦去，再写新的日期。留下来的不是一个英雄，而是一种今天做不到时仍知道该去问谁的办法。
text.en:
I have a morning to continue searching for my brother, then return for my watch. Nobody assumes another person’s entire life. Several people join the small portions they can manage.
Chalk dates by the stove will be erased and replaced. What remains is no hero, but a way to know whom to ask when today becomes too much.

text.zh: 窗口开始核对今夜的票。已核实远行条件，可以把过江当作离沪的第一步；也可以取回周姨的短笺，退掉这张票，带着已经厘清的责任回去。
text.en: The window checks tonight’s tickets. With onward preparations verified, the crossing can begin a departure. Or retrieve Zhou’s note, cancel the ticket, and return with clearer responsibilities.

label.zh: 按核对过的安排登船，继续远行
label.en: Board and follow the verified onward plan

label.zh: 取回短笺，退票回到槐生里
label.en: Retrieve the note, cancel, and return to the lane

text.zh:
问讯员在票角剪下一个小口，告诉我到对岸以后先在哪里等。他不认识我的弟弟，也不知道我为何要走。我没有把他的一句指路解释成对整段路的保证。
上船前，我检查了一遍交接收条和地址簿。林岚没有来送，她要回去开铺；周姨要替楼上的孩子热水。没有人在岸边排成一列目送我，生活仍旧有它各自不能耽搁的事。
text.en:
The clerk clips the ticket and tells me where to wait across the river. He knows neither my brother nor my reasons. Directions are not a guarantee for the whole journey.
I check the receipts and address book. Lin must open the shop; Zhou heats water for the child upstairs. Nobody forms a farewell line. Their lives have tasks that cannot wait.

text.zh:
船离岸的时候，上海没有一下子消失。窗里仍是熟悉的屋顶，只是角度缓缓变了。我把手放在纸包上，想起弟弟十一年前替我提走的那只箱子，如今只能由自己提着。
对岸还会有询问，有拒绝，也可能有一张让我暂时坐下的凳子。我没有把将来写成已经获得的自由，只在信纸背面添上一个能够回信的转交办法。
text.en:
Shanghai does not vanish when the ferry leaves. Familiar roofs slowly change angle. I rest a hand on the papers and remember the case my brother carried eleven years ago. This one is mine to carry.
There may be questions and refusal across the river, perhaps a stool offered briefly. I do not describe freedom as already won. I add a forwarding arrangement for replies.

text.zh:
到了约定的门前，我没有立刻把所有经历倾倒给开门的人，只先报上姓名，问现在是否方便。那人让开半步，够一个带着行李的人站进避雨的地方。
离开上海的路从这个小小的半步继续，仍然曲折，仍然没有弟弟的答案。至少这一次，我带走的不是一份替一切作结的判词，而是一封还能往来下去的信。
text.en:
At the agreed door I give my name and ask whether this is a suitable time, rather than pouring out my whole history. The person moves half a step, enough for someone with a bag to shelter from rain.
The road away continues from that small space, uncertain and without my brother’s answer. I carry not a verdict closing everything, but a letter that may yet receive a reply.

text.zh:
我把票交回窗口，说明不再乘这一班。问讯员划掉的是一次行程，不是对一个人的评价。取回写给周姨的短笺时，我竟松了一口气：至少不会有人因为我没有真正离开，却迟迟等不到回信。
皮箱没有白收拾。哪些材料该带，哪些承诺不能丢，已经清楚写在纸上。只是今晚我选择用这些准备把生活接回去，而不是推到对岸再说。
text.en:
I return the ticket. The clerk cancels a journey, not a judgment on a person. Retrieving Zhou’s note brings relief: nobody will wait for news of a departure that never occurred.
Packing was not wasted. The papers and promises are clearer. Tonight I will use that preparation to resume life here, rather than postpone it to the far bank.

text.zh:
槐生里的灯还没全灭。周姨见我回来，只问吃过没有。我说没有，她指了指炉边，没替我的决定起一个好听的名字，也没有说早知道我走不了。
我把钥匙交接单改成新的日期，再去诊所说明还在本地。那些原本为离开准备的通知，一份份改成留下来的安排。决定有了后果，不只是把船票藏回口袋。
text.en:
Some lane lights remain on. Zhou asks whether I have eaten and points to the stove. She gives my decision no noble name, nor says she knew I would fail to leave.
I update the key handover and tell the clinic I remain nearby. Departure notices become arrangements for staying. The decision has consequences beyond putting the ticket away.

text.zh:
天亮时，我把皮箱放回床脚，没有把它锁死。以后仍可能有另一班船，但不必由今晚替所有以后回答。
桌上的图纸还缺一扇窗。我没有立刻拿笔去补，而是先把今天能够完成的事情写在旁边：回访保管人，送一张更正的收条，继续问弟弟的去向。回到原处，也可以从不同的地方开始。
text.en:
At dawn the suitcase returns beneath the bed, unlocked. There may be another sailing; tonight need not answer for every future night.
A drawing still lacks a window. Before adding it, I list what I can actually do today: visit a keeper, deliver a corrected receipt, ask again about my brother. Returning to a place can still mean beginning elsewhere.

text.zh: 问讯员已经取消代你托交的安排。现在只剩你自己的陈述：可以把它销毁，让调查在自己这里停下；若先前保留了草稿，也可以封存未寄，把将来的决定留给以后。
text.en: Forwarding on your behalf has been cancelled. Your own statement remains. You may destroy it and stop your inquiry, or, if you retained a draft, seal it undelivered and leave a future decision open.

label.zh: 销毁自己的陈述，停止继续追查
label.en: Destroy my statement and stop the inquiry

label.zh: 封存已经保留的草稿，不寄也不否认
label.en: Seal the retained draft without submitting or denying it

text.zh:
问讯员让出炉边的位置，我把属于自己的那几页一张张放进去。名册原件不在这里，医生的记录和林岚的纸也不在这里。我没有得到一场能让所有人一起忘掉过去的火。
纸卷起来时，我认出自己写错又改过的一个字。它最后比旁边的墨迹多亮了一瞬，便也看不清了。烧掉陈述没有改变那件事发生过，只使以后少了一个能够读到我声音的地方。
text.en:
The clerk makes room by the stove. I feed in only my own pages. The register, Luo’s records, and Lin’s papers are elsewhere. There is no fire capable of making everyone forget together.
A corrected character briefly glows as the sheet curls. Destroying the statement changes no event. It removes one place where a future reader could hear my voice.

text.zh:
林岚来收回空封套，没有问我后不后悔。我说她可以保留自己已经写下的东西，不需要为了照顾我的决定也跟着烧掉。她说这本来就是她要自己决定的事。
我们道别时，隔着一张刚擦过的桌子。我知道有些亲近不会因为一夜的共同经历便永久留下，也不会因为分道就证明过去的帮助全是假的。
text.en:
Lin retrieves the empty folder without asking whether I regret it. I say she may retain her own record. She reminds me that was always her decision.
We part across a freshly wiped table. Shared danger guarantees no permanent closeness; different paths do not make earlier help false.

text.zh:
往后的日子里，我没有再主动递出陈述。弟弟的家信仍留在合影后面，偶尔翻开，纸边已经比今晚柔软。
别人问起那一夜，我有时说走了很远，有时什么也不说。生活并未因此安稳，害怕也没有完全消失。只是从此有一段可以被留下的自述，在我亲手点过的炉火里停住了。
text.en:
Afterward I do not submit another statement. The family letter remains behind the photograph, its edges softening with occasional handling.
Asked about that night, I sometimes say I walked far, sometimes nothing. Life is not thereby secure, nor fear gone. One account that might have survived stopped in a fire I chose.

text.zh:
我在封口上写下今晚的日期，没有填写收件人。问讯员提醒我，这样就不会成为一件已经受理的事。我说知道，不需要他用一个回执安慰我。
封套回到我的手里。它没有发出，也没有作废；其中每一句尚未确定的话都带着记号，不能在多年以后被我偷偷改称当时就已知道的事实。
text.en:
I date the seal but leave the recipient blank. The clerk warns that nothing has been formally received. I understand; I need no comforting receipt.
The folder returns to my hands, neither sent nor void. Uncertain sentences are marked, so I cannot later pretend I knew them as facts tonight.

text.zh:
我回旧屋，把封套放到与家信不同的抽屉。周姨只知道有一份私人物件需要防潮，不必替它承担一份她没有读过的责任。
放好以后，我没有马上觉得轻松。留着它意味着可能再看见自己的退缩，也意味着将来如果愿意，仍能找到那个正在犹豫的人亲手写下的经过。
text.en:
At home I place the folder in a drawer separate from the family letter. Zhou knows only that a private paper needs keeping dry, not that she must answer for unread contents.
Relief does not arrive immediately. Keeping it means meeting my hesitation again. It also lets a future self find the account written by the person hesitating now.

text.zh:
后来某个晴天，我把抽屉里的纸拿出来晒。封口还在，收件人那一栏仍空着。窗外有人叫卖，城市并没有因为一封未寄的信停下来等我。
我也没有把等待说成已经完成的勇敢。只是把纸翻到背面，记下这次检视的日期。那封信还没有出发，但它暂时仍有出发的可能。
text.en:
On a later dry day I air the papers. The seal holds; the recipient remains blank. The city outside has not paused for an unsent letter.
I do not rename waiting as accomplished courage. I turn the folder over and date the inspection. The letter has not begun its journey. For now, it still could.

text.zh:
回去时我经过后弄，没有敲那些收下封套的门。答应过的检视日期还没到，他们也该有一段不被我的事情占据的清晨。我在手记末尾写下自己的名字，旁边是下一次核对的日期。
留名没有使夜色一下子退去。它只是让将来的追问找到一个愿意回答“这一部分是我核对的，其余我还不知道”的人。
text.en:
I pass the rear court without knocking. The agreed inspection date has not arrived; the keepers deserve a morning not occupied by my case. I put my name beside the next verification date.
Leaving a name does not dispel the dark. It gives a future question someone willing to answer: I checked this part; the rest I do not yet know.

subtitle.en: Leaving is another way to go on living.

text.zh:
到了约定的门前，我没有立刻把所有经历倾倒给开门的人，只先报上姓名，问现在是否方便。那人让开半步，够一个带着行李的人站进避雨的地方。
离开上海的路从这个小小的半步继续，仍然曲折，仍然没有弟弟的答案。至少这一次，我带走的不是一份替一切作结的判词，而是一封还能往来下去的信。
text.en:
At the agreed door I give my name and ask whether this is a suitable time, rather than pouring out my whole history. The person moves half a step, enough for someone with a bag to shelter from rain.
The road away continues from that small space, uncertain and without my brother’s answer. I carry not a verdict closing everything, but a letter that may yet receive a reply.

subtitle.en: The fire dies. The rain goes on.

subtitle.zh: 留一盏灯，等一个未归的人。
subtitle.en: Keep a lamp for someone yet to return.

text.zh:
第三夜结束以后，我还要重新问他，也要重新看自己的日程。留下是一件需要不断确认的事，不是今晚的一次选择替所有以后签好名。
手记里关于弟弟的那几页没有合上。我把灯往顾先生看得见的地方移了些，等天亮后，再继续写自己不知道的部分。
text.en:
After the third night I must ask again and check my own schedule. Staying requires renewed agreement, not one decision signing for every future day.
The pages about my brother remain open. I move the lamp where Gu can see it. After dawn I will continue recording what I do not know.

subtitle.zh: 纸留下了，名字仍在封套里。
subtitle.en: The papers remain; the name stays sealed.

text.zh:
几年以后，是否会有人按编号找到这只封套，我不能预知。清晨的水槽边，有人照常洗碗，封套就在离水声很近的地方，被仔细垫高了一寸。
我仍在这座城市里，没有恢复原来的职位，也没有得到一个能大声讲述的胜利。只是有一份不署名的记录，暂时没有消失。
text.en:
I cannot know whether anyone will follow the reference years from now. At dawn someone washes dishes by the sink. Nearby, the folder is carefully raised an inch above the damp.
I remain in the city without my old position or a victory to announce. For now, an unsigned record has not disappeared.

subtitle.zh: 几个人各自接住一小段夜。
subtitle.en: Several people take a small part of the night.

text.zh:
我终于能腾出一个上午继续查弟弟的事，也能按时回来接自己的班。没有谁接过别人全部的人生，只有几个人把力所能及的一小段接在一起。
煤炉旁的粉笔字会被擦去，再写新的日期。留下来的不是一个英雄，而是一种今天做不到时仍知道该去问谁的办法。
text.en:
I have a morning to continue searching for my brother, then return for my watch. Nobody assumes another person’s entire life. Several people join the small portions they can manage.
Chalk dates by the stove will be erased and replaced. What remains is no hero, but a way to know whom to ask when today becomes too much.

subtitle.zh: 退回一张票，重新安排明天。
subtitle.en: One cancelled ticket, tomorrow arranged anew.

text.zh:
天亮时，我把皮箱放回床脚，没有把它锁死。以后仍可能有另一班船，但不必由今晚替所有以后回答。
桌上的图纸还缺一扇窗。我没有立刻拿笔去补，而是先把今天能够完成的事情写在旁边：回访保管人，送一张更正的收条，继续问弟弟的去向。回到原处，也可以从不同的地方开始。
text.en:
At dawn the suitcase returns beneath the bed, unlocked. There may be another sailing; tonight need not answer for every future night.
A drawing still lacks a window. Before adding it, I list what I can actually do today: visit a keeper, deliver a corrected receipt, ask again about my brother. Returning to a place can still mean beginning elsewhere.
